race.title: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: DIAMOND GEEZER has shaped as though capable of defying this sort of mark and can land a fourth handicap success. Jury's In heads the dangers, with steadily-improving Frisky Whiskey also appealing in a competitive handicap. DIAMOND GEEZER (IRE) JURY'S IN (IRE) FRISKY WHISKEY
